svg.title: Room materials: separate surface values from incoming light
svg.desc: Four unchanged Unreal viewport captures of the baseline room show base color, roughness, metallic and lit appearance at the same camera. The matte and glossy blocks have different material values. This is not a controlled roughness-only experiment.
svg.text: Room materials: separate surface values from incoming light
The red and green walls store surface color.
Bright matte block; darker glossy block.
The glossy block also changes metal response.
These values respond to the ceiling light and GI.
Actual Unreal captures, unchanged camera and baseline room.
The two blocks differ in multiple parameters; this comparison does not isolate roughness alone.
